lines: All right. I am willing to let this cool down.
Fine. I will step back.
I have heard enough to lower my hands.
We can stop here before anyone gets hurt.
I accept the effort. Do not waste it.
Take a breath. I will do the same.
This does not erase what happened, but it ends the fight.
I am still angry, though I no longer want blood.
Keep your distance and we can leave peacefully.
All right. Let us settle this without another wound.
I will not strike if you do not threaten me again.
You have one chance to walk away calmly.
The village has seen enough violence today.
I would rather talk tomorrow than fight tonight.
Fine. Put it down and I will do the same.
We can end this now.
I believe you want peace. Show me by leaving quietly.
My anger is not worth another injured neighbor.
I will accept the truce.
Go carefully. Trust has not returned with the silence.
You are short. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
That is not the agreed amount. I need {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Count again. The cost is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
I cannot accept less than {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
The full payment is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
You still owe enough to make {emerald_cost} {emeralds} in total.
This offer does not cover the harm. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
I said {emerald_cost} {emeralds}, and I meant it.
Come back when you have all {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
We are not settled until the payment reaches {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
That is only part of what you owe.
The amount has not changed. It remains {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Do not make me count this a third time.
You cannot bargain the cost down after the damage is done.
The village expects the full {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
This is not enough to settle anything.
Bring the missing emeralds and we can finish this.
I will wait for the complete payment.
You knew the cost before you made this offer.
Return with {emerald_cost} {emeralds}, not another excuse.
No. This wound is not ready to close.
Payment cannot fix this yet.
I do not trust you enough to make terms.
Keep {payment_items}. I need distance.
No amount of {payment_items} will settle what happened today.
{payment_items} cannot buy forgiveness from me.
The damage is too fresh for bargaining.
I am not willing to discuss peace with you.
Leave before this becomes worse.
Trust has to exist before an agreement can.
I will not pretend a payment makes me safe.
There is nothing in {payment_items} that I want from you right now.
Not today. Perhaps not for a long time.
This is not a debt {payment_items} can simply pay.
I need changed behavior, not another offer.
The village still has reason to fear you.
You have crossed a line that emeralds cannot move.
Do not reach for {payment_items}. Just go.
I am refusing the bargain, not asking for more.
Come back only after your actions have changed.
